pkgmetadata.longdescription: Small pybind11-based Python bindings for whisper.cpp, OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition model ported to C/C++. Links against the system app-accessibility/whisper-cpp library rather than the bundled copy upstream vendors as a git submodule.
